about: Hand-made meetings for the speaker loop's names (MEETINGS.md D42, MOM-08), written by Claude on 27 Oct 2026. Each line is [speaker, words]; `gold` is each speaker's real name, null when the meeting never says it; `sure` the speakers named on two or more lines, so the loop may apply their name (fewer is a suggestion at most).

meetings.name: intro-both
lines: Hi everyone, I'm Joanne, thanks for coming over.
Thanks Joanne, the place looks great.
Noah, can you grab the mezuzah from the car?
Sure, I'll get it now.
Great, thank you Noah.
Joanne, where do you want it hung?

meetings.name: once-only
lines: Okay, let's start with the budget.
Thanks, Priya. I have the numbers here.
Go ahead.
We're about ten percent over on travel.
That's fine for this quarter.

meetings.name: absent-person
lines: Did Rabbi Ian confirm for Sunday?
Not yet, I'll call Rabbi Ian tonight.
If he can't make it, ask Rabbi Eden.
Okay, I'll ask Rabbi Eden as a backup.

meetings.name: no-names
lines: So the deploy failed again last night.
Same error as Tuesday?
Yes, the migration timed out.
Let's raise the timeout and retry.
Agreed, I'll do it after lunch.

meetings.name: handover
lines: Welcome to the quarterly review. Over to you, Maya, for the sales numbers.
Thanks. Sales grew twelve percent this quarter.
Maya, how much of that is the new region?
About half of it, so six points.
Great work, Maya. Arjun, you're up with hiring.
Thanks. We hired four engineers and one designer.
Arjun, are the designer's start dates set?
Yes, she starts on the first.

meetings.name: caller-not-here
lines: Hi Noah, can you hear me? Noah is on the phone, he's stuck in traffic.
Okay, let's start without him.
Yes, Noah said to go ahead.
First item is the lease renewal.

meetings.name: self-intro-panel
lines: Let's go around the room. I'm Sam, I run the platform team.
I'm Lena, I'm on design.
And I'm Omar from support.
Thanks Lena. Omar, what are you hearing from customers?
Mostly questions about the new billing page.
Sam, we could add a short explainer there.
Good idea, Lena, let's do it.

meetings.name: third-person
lines: As Priya said yesterday, we can't ship on the fifth.
Right, billing needs another week.
Priya also wants the FAQ done first.
I'll finish the FAQ by Friday then.

meetings.name: addressed-twice
lines: Okay, quick sync on the launch.
Dana, is the landing page ready?
Almost, the copy is in review.
Thanks Dana. What's left on the copy?
Two headlines and the pricing blurb.
Let's ship it Friday then.

meetings.name: on-behalf
lines: Hi, I'm calling for Dr. Rao about the results.
Sure, can I take your name?
It's Kofi, I'm her assistant.
Thanks Kofi, she'll call you back after two.
Great, thank you.

meetings.name: corrected-name
lines: Welcome, John, glad you could make it.
Thanks, it's Jon without the h, by the way.
Sorry, Jon. Let's look at the roadmap.
Sure. I think search should come first.
Agreed, Jon, search first.

meetings.name: similar-names
lines: Ana, can you take the notes today?
Sure. Anna is out, so I'll cover her items too.
Ana, did Anna send the vendor list?
She did, I'll forward it.
Thanks Ana.

meetings.name: sign-off-only
lines: So the server move is Saturday night.
Yes, I'll be on call.
And the rollback plan is ready?
It is. Talk soon, this was Ravi from infra.

meetings.name: group-greeting
lines: Morning Lucia, morning Tom.
Morning! Tom, did the boxes arrive?
They did, Lucia, all twelve.
Great, let's unpack after lunch.
I'll grab the cutter.

meetings.name: pet-name
lines: Max, sit. Good boy, Max.
He's so well trained now.
It took months. Anyway, how was the trip?
Long, but the hotel was lovely.

meetings.name: interview
lines: Thanks for joining us, Mei. Could you start with your background?
Sure. I spent five years building payment systems.
Mei, what was the hardest outage you handled?
A double-charge bug on a holiday weekend.
How did you find it?
We traced the retries in the logs.
